title: Isandro and the Machine
author: Oscar Ishikawa
blurb: Mara Galloway, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
